description: A subtle, rectilinear raised platform with embanked margins. In the hillshade derivative this feature appears as a flat-topped terrace approximately 120 m long (E–W) by 80 m wide (N–S), bounded by low scarps. Cross‐checking with the NIR band shows a narrow zone of enhanced moisture (darker tones) along its western edge, consistent with sediment‐filled peripheral ditches or dark earth accumulation.

A linear depression (ditch or canal fragment) trending NW–SE over approximately 500 m. It shows up as a curvilinear trough in curvature lows and as a distinct linear moisture anomaly (darker pixels) in the NIR image. The feature lies upslope of the main drainage line, suggesting intentional water diversion or field irrigation.
